events.name: CLOSE
events.description: The viewer dismissed the notification overlay.

events.name: OPEN
events.description: The viewer asked to see notifications.
events.synonyms: show notifications, open bell, view alerts

overridableConfigKeys.label: What should the dismiss button say?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Label on the button that closes the overlay.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: dismiss label, close label, back label

overridableConfigKeys.label: What shows when there are no notifications?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Message rendered in place of the list when there is nothing to show.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: empty state, no notifications, nothing here

overridableConfigKeys.label: Which icon appears in the overlay header?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Lucide icon name shown next to the overlay title.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: header icon, bell icon, panel icon

overridableConfigKeys.label: Which notifications should the overlay list?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Items rendered in the overlay — the same list std-app-layout takes for its bell dropdown.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Render slot
overridableConfigKeys.description: UI slot the overlay renders into. Never `main` — repainting main is what strands the viewer.

overridableConfigKeys.label: What should the overlay heading say?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Heading displayed at the top of the notification overlay.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: panel title, overlay heading, notifications title

capabilities: notification overlay, alerts panel, bell dropdown, notification centre, inbox overlay
